title: Prepping for Packers — Nix Set for Debut, Will Waddle Be There Too? | Orange & Blue Today
text: The Broncos were back on the field after their preseason win over the Falcons, and Monday’s practice had a clear theme: prep for preseason game No. 2 — and the return of some major firepower. It was great to see Jaylen Waddle back out there. His presence instantly changes spacing, tempo, and how the defense reacts. Even in limited work, the offense looks different with him on the field. And yes — Bo Nix should make his preseason debut against the Packers. He’s been sharp in camp, fully practicing, and showing command. What should fans expect. Timing, rhythm throws, quick decisions, and a controlled script designed to get him comfortable without unnecessary risk. Rookie RB Jonah Coleman was amazing against the Falcons — physical, explosive, confident. So what more do the Broncos need to see. Pass protection consistency, continued ball security, and proof he can handle situational work. If he checks those boxes, his role could grow fast. This week is about sharpening the offense, reintegrating key starters, and building on a strong preseason opener. 🔥 In this episode: Jaylen Waddle returns to practice Bo Nix set for his preseason debut Jonah Coleman’s next steps after a breakout performance How the offense evolves with starters back What to watch for vs. the Packers Drop your Broncos take — what do YOU want to see from Nix, and how big should Coleman’s role be in preseason game No. 2.
